releases.displayName: Killing Floor 3 Halloween Hotfix is Live!

items.text: We are releasing a PC client only hotfix to address the following issues:
• Fix for Antarctic Base aggressive stuttering until map is fully loaded.
• Fix for a GPU crash that some players are experiencing.
• Improvement to how the client and server interact that should mitigate clients getting "removed from a server" they were still connected to via a connection timeout.
• Improved logging for client issues.

releases.displayName: Server Side Hotfix Deployed - Fixes A Leading Case Of "Lost Connection To Host"

items.text: Nightfall,

We deployed a server hotfix late yesterday to address a crash that could sometimes occur when a player was joining an in progress game. We believe this was a leading cause of some players experiencing the "Lost Connection To Host" error.
We are continuing to monitor and as always, please let us know about any issues you are experiencing so we can investigate.

releases.displayName: PC Client Only Hotfix Is Now Being Deployed

items.text: This update fixes an issue where some clients could get stuck in the compiling shaders screen during launch due to a rare race condition.
Thank you to all the community members who worked with us to figure out, test and resolve this issue.

releases.displayName: [PSA] Investigation Update - Stuck on Compile Shaders Hotfix Beta

items.text: We have been tracking player reports of shaders failing to complete their load on launch. While we have not be able to reproduce this bug internally, thanks to these reports and continued details from players about what they are experiencing we have been able to get leads on what the cause is. We are working to get a hotfix out as soon as possible. The next step is to get a Hotfix Beta into the hands of those who are affected. We are looking for volunteers who have run into the stuck shader issue. Please reply here to let us know if you are interested and you will be contacted with more information. Please note that we may note be able to respond to every reply before the update starts to roll out more widely.

releases.displayName: Killing Floor 3: Halloween Horrors Update Is Here!

items.text: The Fall 2026 Update brings the return of the fan favorite Halloween Horrors event!
The zeds have all dressed up in their seasonal best, calling back the famous horror films.
[img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/092326/howlgroup.png"]

A mysterious call has led Nightfall to a Haunted Hotel deep in Romania, can you survive long enough to discover the secrets these walls hold? Enter the Hotel Iorga this Halloween Season, but be warned: you aren’t the first special guests to check-in, and if you aren’t careful, you may never check-out.
[p align="center"]
[img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/092326/welcome.png"]
These additions have received updated animations and are tuned along with the existing dualie options to be meaningful, viable picks for gunslingers and other zed hunters.

Most enemy body shots deal heavily reduced damage while critical zones take increased damage. Armor zones protecting critical zones receive the damage bonus.This mutator rewards precision, and the cost of missing scales sharply by difficulty.

Heat and Electrical damage types deal significant damage to enemies. This boost includes traps as well. This restricts weapon choices to electrical and fire loadouts while encouraging creative use of environmental hazards.
Every wave before the boss wave randomly rolls either a trick or a treat. Tricks are purely negative mutators, and treats are purely positive ones.
The weekly removes many of the new features from Killing Floor 3 for an experience reminiscent of older Killing Floors in the new setting. Enemy damage is reduced.
Sliding and dashing are removed.
Gadgets are disabled.
Syringes refill every 30 seconds and their healing is reduced by 25%.
Enemy kills return ammunition, but trader ammunition costs are increased. Ballistic and cut damage is increased.
Daily
An Unpleasant Stay - Survive The Haunted Hotel
Extended Stay - Survive Haunted Hotel On Long
An Unpleasant Stay
Survive Haunted Hotel on Normal Difficulty
Survive Haunted Hotel on Hard Difficulty
Survive Haunted Hotel on Suicidal Difficulty
Survive Haunted Hotel on Hell On Earth Difficulty
Feed Me Seymour - Get 10 kills with a single use of the Haunted Hotel plant trap.
Toy Soldier - Destroy 10 collectibles in Haunted Hotel

One last thing we wanted to mention is the addition of Double XP Events and Tokens players can acquire. From time to time, Double XP events may be run for all players, but players can also obtain a “2XP Token” once per day with excess supply pass tokens they have earned. These tokens will last an hour from the point of purchase during active wave gameplay (and are paused during such things like Trader Time).
The game has been updated to use FSR 4, improving graphics quality and performance compared to previous FSR versions.
Tuned core and thread utilization for PCs with 6 or less cores when compiling shaders.
Reduced number of global shaders needed at startup.
Level specific shaders now compile behind the scene while in the HUB map.
Fixed frame rate drops during the Alpha Scavenger's callout ability, and made all melee attacks cheaper to process, especially around physics objects and destructibles.
Zeds directly in front of you now animate smoothly on lower-end hardware and consoles. Distant and off-screen Zeds still use reduced animation updates to save performance.
Skill abilities now load in the background when you change Perk, instead of loading mid-match and causing hitches.
Fixed projectiles that missed everything (such as shots fired into the sky) staying alive for the rest of the match and adding up over time.
Fixed some visual effects freezing in place on lower-end machines
Horzine Labs' incubation tanks are see-through again, without bringing back the frame rate drop from the destructible tanks.
This update has a broad rebalance of how Zeds behave, how dangerous they are, and how many of them you meet at once. Two things drive almost everything below: difficulty and squad size.
-Lead Game Designer Brent Caulfield

Normal and Hard are meaningfully less punishing. A long list of the deadliest Zed abilities like Husk's Mortar and Hover Fireball Volley, Siren's Sonic Projectile, Fleshpound's Rush and Enrage Ground Pound, several of Scrake's enraged attacks all no longer fire at these difficulties at all. Big Zeds are also softer and easier to stagger here. If you're learning a Perk or bringing new players in, the lower difficulties should feel much more like a ramp and less like a wall.

Suicidal and Hell on Earth are less crowded but far more lethal. You'll face fewer specials at once and get longer gaps between special spawn groups but the ones that do show up now use their signature abilities at almost every opportunity rather than occasionally. Scrakes will reach for the hook. Fleshpounds will commit to Enrage Ground Pound. Sirens will scream on cooldown. The intent is that top-difficulty fights are decided by how you handle a small number of genuinely dangerous Zeds, rather than by how much you can hold back at once.

Squad size now matters much more than it used to. Scrake and Fleshpound health and Interrupt Affliction resistance both scale hard with player count. In a full six-player squad they are substantially tankier and far harder to stagger than before. A full squad on Hell on Earth will find crowd control noticeably less reliable against them. The flip side is that solo and duo players will find their limbs and heads come off faster than before. Where you hit matters too: armour now absorbs most stagger build-up, while headshots and critical hits absorb none.

Early waves have been thinned out on higher difficulties. Husk density in particular was cut sharply, and Scrake and Fleshpound counts were reduced in late-wave and finale groups across every difficulty and squad size.
Husks
Shows up less often in early waves, its fireballs travel slower, and it no longer uses Mortar or Hover Fireball Volley on Normal
Siren

Her Scream no longer shoves you around and slows you instead, and she now screams and fires Sonic Projectiles relentlessly on Suicidal and Hell on Earth while losing the projectile entirely on Normal and Hard.
Fleshpound

Fewer of them, but each one enrages sooner and more visibly, shrugs off stagger far better in larger squads, and commits harder to its deadliest attacks at high difficulty, while becoming noticeably tamer on Normal and Hard.
Scrake

Fewer of them, but they move much faster, are far harder to stagger in larger squads, and will reach for the hook and chainsaw at every opportunity on Hell on Earth, while giving up several of their nastiest attacks on Normal and Hard.

This update also includes a broad balance pass focused on improving underperforming weapons, strengthening Sharpshooter’s role against armored large Zeds, continuing to refine the Gunslinger - while also working in the singles into the balance and making them feel like a viable, meaningful pick, tightening the Suicidal and Hell on Earth economies, and fixing a variety of weapon/mod inconsistencies.
-Lead Game Designer Brent Caulfield
Core Combat and Economy

Damage-over-time afflictions have been standardized. Burn now lasts 3 seconds, while Bleed, Corrosive, and Toxic last 5 seconds. Total DoT damage now scales directly with the amount of affliction applied, rather than using flat damage values.
Parries now provide clearer feedback with a more obvious green shield effect.
Suicidal grants less dosh from starting resources, kills, revives, executions, and respawns. The goal is to prevent players from consistently reaching full builds by waves 2–3.
Hell on Earth grants less dosh across the same sources. The economy should now require more meaningful purchasing decisions and provide a more demanding progression curve.
Sharpshooter
The Sharpshooter changes are intended to make the perk more effective against Scrakes, Fleshpounds, and other armored threats.
Untouchable and Big Shot now increase Ballistic and Cold weapon damage instead of only increasing weak-spot damage.
Evasive Maneuvers now grants 20% movement speed for 5 seconds after taking damage, along with 15/20/25/30% damage reduction during that time.
Field Supplies has been replaced by Trapper.
Medium Zed kills grant 1 stack.
Participating in a large Zed takedown grants 10 stacks.
At 20/17/14/10 stacks, all stacks are consumed to restore 1 tool ammo.
This only supports the Explosive Lock, Shock Trap, and Pulse Lure.
Flight Response has been replaced by Full Metal Jacket, which grants 20/27/34/40% increased Ballistic and Cold damage against armor hit zones.
Perfect Shot now increases general Ballistic and Cold weapon damage rather than only weak-spot damage.
Missing removes 2 stacks instead of removing every stack.
Damage per stack has been reduced from 4/5/6/7% to 2/3/4/5% to compensate for the improved consistency.
Weapon Adjustments
Samaritan
Freeze Power increased from 75 to 150.
Accuracy increased by 50%.
Magazine increased from 6 to 8.
Extended Magazine increased from 10 to 12.
Recoil is more predictable, with lower recoil while aiming down sights but higher hip-fire recoil.
Cold Ammo is now available.
Poly-Synthetic, Reactive Alloy, and Electric Ammo now correctly remove Freeze.
Lightweight Magazine now reloads 7 rounds rather than mistakenly reloading only 5.
Stormguard
Magazine increased from 40 to 50.
Extended Magazine increased to 60; Lightweight Magazine increased to 45.
Reserve ammunition increased from 560 to 700.
Accuracy recovers much faster after firing.
Moving while firing no longer applies an accuracy penalty.
Full-auto recoil is more consistent and predictable.
Knightsbridge
Magazine increased from 60 to 90.
Powered Box Magazine increased to 80; Drum Magazine increased to 110.
Reserve ammunition increased from 1,020 to 1,260.
Bloodhound P330
Single-wield reserve ammunition increased from 120 to 200.
Dual-wield reserve ammunition increased from 240 to 400.
Artemis Marksman
Time between shots within a burst reduced from 0.12 seconds to 0.05 seconds.
Recovery time between bursts is slightly longer.
The Extra Burst Receiver now adds fewer shots per burst to control overall damage output.
Secondary-fire damage should now display correctly in the Armory and Trader.
Biomorphic Projector
Base damage increased from 70 to 85.
Lock-on damage begins higher and ramps considerably faster, with the greatest improvement during the first two seconds.
Fully charged damage is also higher.
Secondary enemies caught in the beam now receive escalating damage.
Base healing increased from 3 to 5 per tick.
Healing begins much stronger, particularly during the first second.
Additional allies caught in the beam receive increased healing.
The Slowed-Tick Receiver now increases healing per tick enough to offset its slower tick rate, preserving total healing output.
Gunslinger Weapon Adjustments
Dual AF2081-A1s
All reload speeds have received a slight buff.
Simultaneous-fire rate reduced by approximately 22%.
AF2081-A1 Carbon Fiber Internal
Fire-rate bonus reduced from 33% to 25%.
Cost increased from 380 to 490 dosh.
AF2081-A1 Tungsten Receiver
Maximum damage bonus reduced from 30% to 23%.
Scaling has been flattened slightly, with the first level receiving a small increase.
Dual Desert Eagles
Simultaneous-fire rate reduced by approximately 33%.
Accuracy slightly reduced.
The weapons now correctly deal Sonic damage for assignment tracking.
Desert Eagle Multi-Round Burst
Maximum damage bonus reduced from 9% to 6%.
Fire rate has also been adjusted.
Gunslinger Gravitational Force
Vulnerability reduced from 15/20/25/30% to 10/13/16/20%.
Opening Salvo now correctly applies its damage bonus to pistols using Multi-Round Burst mods.
Heavy Hitters should no longer pass through enemies when the player has no locked target.
Magazine and Mod Tuning
2058 Lawbringer Five-Round Cylinder: Damage bonus now begins at 20% instead of only reaching 20% when fully upgraded.
Desert Eagle Powered Polymer: Damage bonus increased to approximately 17–20%.
Desert Eagle Extended Magazine: Bonus ammunition reduced from +4 to +3 rounds.
Der Konig Lightweight Magazine: Capacity increased from 12 to 13; cost increased from 90 to 130 dosh.
Der Konig Extended Magazine: Cost reduced from 290 to 240 dosh.
AF2081-A1 Lightweight Magazine: Cost increased from 110 to 140 dosh; reload-speed bonus reduced by approximately 7%.
Night Adder Lightweight Magazine: Cost increased from 80 to 110 dosh.
Night Adder Carbon Fiber: Now sells for the intended 300 dosh instead of 200.
Fixed an issue where party members were unable to join an in-progress match directly from the social list.
Resolved a matchmaking error where lobbies were unable to initiate matchmaking while in the Stronghold.
Fixed an issue where clients encountered "Network Error 5" when attempting to rejoin a party following a crash.
Resolved client disconnections occurring during online matches on Sewers.
Fixed an issue on the Epic Games Store where clean installations failed to launch due to missing .dll errors.
Fixed an issue on Xbox Series X where the title could freeze on the intro splash sequence.
General Gameplay & Combat
Scrake: Resolved an issue where base sprint speeds erroneously utilized enraged sprint speed modifiers. Scrakes will no longer wander headless for extended periods following decapitation.
Chimera: Fixed an issue where the Chimera failed to execute its mire orb attack on Suicidal and Hell on Earth difficulties.
Queen Crawler: Addressed a bug where baby Crawlers failed to spawn after the Queen Crawler's abdomen broke off.
Crawler: Fixed an issue where Crawlers occasionally displayed duplicate head meshes following decapitation.

Husk: Fixed an exploit where Husk AI could be manipulated to jump within melee range by standing near laser grids on Onslaught. Husk fireball projectile homing has also been re-tuned to intended parameters.
Moorcroft: Fixed an issue where Halloween Moorcroft spawned with pre-existing damage, and resolved an issue where defeating Moorcroft erroneously unlocked the Alpha Scavenger achievement.
Fixed an issue where landing on a boss's head could instantly eliminate it.
Resolved an issue where a second Molotov lost collision with Zeds directly impacted by the first.
Fixed an issue where projectiles could remain persistent indefinitely when fired directly into the sky.
Addressed an issue where rapidly sliding, toggling sprint, and firing could cause weapons to become unresponsive.
Fixed an issue where players could become locked in grab animations if downed or grabbed while using a healing syringe.
Resolved a targeting priority bug where reviving downed teammates would inadvertently switch targets when players were downed in close proximity.
Fixed an issue where weapons equipped with underbarrel launchers received reserve ammo they could not access.
Addressed an issue allowing non-host lobby members to invoke the map selection list during Weekly Mutations.
Specialists, Perks & Skills
Fixed an issue where the "Perfect Shot" perk skill did not stack with boss weak point hits.
Fixed localization for the Level 20 passive skill "Full Metal Jacket" in non-English languages.
Fixed an issue where switching fire modes on the Bonebreaker shotgun disabled the "Scatter Plot" skill.
Resolved an issue where triggering Zed Time while using the Sonic Storm gadget caused primary fire functionality to lock.
Restored missing ground decals and flame visual effects for Firebug gadgets on Medium, High, and Ultra video settings.
Fixed an issue where healing darts failed to home in on teammates wearing Skeleton outfits or Glowing Ghoul skins.
Fixed an issue where healing darts circled around downed players rather than connecting when the Social Distancing skill was active.
Fixed an issue where Gunslinger gadget projectiles passed through the Alpha Scavenger when weak points were closed.
Corrected the "Custom Made" skill calculation to properly discount modded weapon costs at the Trader pod.
Fixed an issue where the "Money-spinner" throwable skill displayed only bonus Dosh rather than total earnings.
Resolved an issue where the Hellion gadget could clip through walls and have its projectiles obstructed.
Weapons, Equipment & Audio
Fixed an issue where weapons could not be reloaded while aiming down sights (ADS).
Resolved an issue where holding aim down sights while reloading after a single shot canceled the reload on Dual 2058 Lawbringers and Dual KH-380s.
Fixed an issue where camera shake persisted after interrupting the secondary fire reload on Dual Disciples.
Fixed an issue in the Trader pod where un-named weapons defaulted to their stock counterparts.
Underbarrel Healing Grenades should now heal consistently regardless of the weapon carrying the mod.
Underbarrel Confusion Darts should no longer affect other players or trigger their damage indicators.
G33 Ammo mods should no longer allow shots to be queued earlier than intended.
Sight mods should correctly modify aim-down-sight transition speed on affected weapons.
Reflex sights and other sights have been recentered on numerous affected weapons, including the Dual 2058 Lawbringers.
Affliction Amplifier mods now correctly increase Stun Affliction.
Dual Der Konig secondary fire now applies the same Stumble as primary fire.
Electric Ammo now removes Freeze from both primary and secondary fire modes.
Brimstone Magnesium Accelerator and Vulcan Supercharged Plasma now correctly add Burn Power.
Cold Ammo now correctly modifies secondary-fire damage.
ESR 36 Precision Internal no longer applies its fire-rate bonus twice.
Weapon stat bars should more accurately reflect accuracy, fire rate, reload speed, and other comparisons.
Weapons with multiple fire modes should report damage and damage types more accurately in the Trader and Armory.
Gunslinger dual-weapon timings have been refined, particularly when certain magazine mods are equipped.
Dual Der Konigs received a slight partial-reload-speed buff.
Dual Katanas and Teko Kagis should correctly label their ammunition as belonging to the secondary fire mode.
MKR350 Drum Magazine should correctly display its recoil penalty as a debuff rather than a buff.
Engineer’s Scatter Plot should now track correctly when changing fire modes.
The Multitool interaction exploit that allowed players to swap weapons or bash without consuming a charge has been fixed.
Fixed placeholder models and textures on the Sharpshooter T2 Artemis in both the Armory and active gameplay.
Resolved floating mesh pieces and missing hand animations on the Engineer ConTek CSG during reloads.
Added missing trinket and sticker customization slots for Dual Disciples in the Armory.
Restored missing weapon reload audio that previously required opening the Trader pod to initialize.
Fixed missing audio and incorrect sound cues for Fleshpound walking and blocking animations.
Maps & Environment
Fixed placeholder textures appearing on rail assets, cement blocks, sliding doors, and metal bars across Medium, High, and Ultra settings.
Fixed placeholder textures on destructible metal doorways.
Addressed harsh, overexposed red lighting in the Cafe area after secondary light sources were destroyed.
Resolved black corrupted textures appearing on destroyed doorways.
Corrected excessive shadow casting on specialist character models in specific lighting volumes.
Fixed an issue where destructible trainyard signal lights momentarily disappeared after breaking.
Fixed missing alpha blend modes on cabinet materials.
Fixed player collision when mantling specific carriers.
Resolved visual obstructions during the Queen Crawler entrance cinematic.
Corrected Z-fighting visual artifacts on roof overhangs at Barracks 04.
Fixed pathing stalls where large Zeds paused on cliff edges instead of engaging specialists.
Corrected Zed pathing through multi-tool doors near the Test Chambers.
Fixed an issue allowing players to equip secondary weapons while in the hub when using a controller.
User Interface, Store & Progression
Fixed an issue where Supply Pass menu pages lost navigation focus after acquiring items.
Fixed an issue where wave progression indicators disappeared from the HUD mid-match.
Resolved erratic menu jumping and auto-scrolling when navigating weapon lists in the Armory.
Corrected store banner and item tile scaling in vertical UI menus.
Corrected missing spaces, untranslated English strings, and syntax errors across French, German, Japanese, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese localizations.
Cosmetics & Armory
Resolved an issue where newly purchased store cosmetics temporarily disappeared from inventory upon entering a match.

We are aware of an issue where some players loading into Arctic Base will experience extreme stuttering until the entire level has been cached locally. The team is working to address this in the very near future.

releases.displayName: The September Quality Of Life Update Is Live!

items.text: Welcome, Nightfall!

We've been closely monitoring your feedback and digging into the data to bring you our September 2026 Update. This patch includes an array of Quality of Life (QoL) improvements, bug fixes, and targeted balance changes across Perks, Weapons, and Zeds.
UI, HUD, & Menus
The scoreboard has been split from the "pause" screen, allowing users to bring it up and view it during gameplay without stopping their movement.
The Boss Name will now show on the Wave Title card
Gameplay/General
Players can now choose the weekly difficulty (such as Hell on Earth)\\
Smoother gameplay while shaders compile

Fixed audio stutter and frame hitches caused by shader compilation. During gameplay, compilation now runs on a limited set of efficiency cores at reduced priority so it no longer fights the game for CPU time
Shaders needed for what's actually on screen now jump to the front of the compile queue, reducing one-off hitches when new effects or enemies appear
Fixed players being held at spawn for minutes on some machines because the game was waiting on background shader work that didn't need to block anyone
Perks & Balance
Addressed several overperforming items such as targeted Gunslinger Skills while improving underperforming areas such as ground fire.
Several key fixes around the Ninja Gadget to help make it feel better and perform as intended
Shader Optimization
First-launch shader optimizations. The game now uses every available CPU core while compiling shaders on the title screen
Fixed a rare startup issue where the game filtered the bundled shaders by the wrong game usage mask
The title screen now caps its own frame rate while shaders are optimizing, so the menu stops competing with compilation for CPU time
Changing your graphics settings now rebuilds the affected shaders at a much faster rate in foreground mode
Players on the Low graphics preset no longer compile shaders for every other quality preset as well
Reduced the total number of shader variants by consolidating weapon, environment, and effects materials
Explosive Situation: Explosion radius reduced by 30%.
Husk
Mortar ability updated to not trigger on Normal difficulty.
Hover Fireball Volley ability updated to not trigger on Normal difficulty.
Desperation Mode updated to increase movement speed by 1.75x.
Desperation Attack baseline damage of explosion increased from 25 to 65 (a 2.6x damage increase). The explosion no longer modifies damage depending on distance from the center.
Fixed an issue with incorrect trigger chances set for the Mortar and Hover Fireball Volley abilities.
Fixed an issue preventing the Husk from sprinting when its Desperation Mode is active.
Fixed an issue with the Husk Desperation Mode and Desperation Attack playing their animations faster than intended.
Moorcroft
Added additional information to the codex about the barrier being neutral to damage types.
All weapon groundfires have had their damage increased from 10 damage per tick to 25-35 depending on the weapon.
Fixed a bug where the Trenchgun's groundfire wasn't dealing damage.
Fixed an issue where the mod wasn't marking targets or dealing bonus damage in the secondary fire mode of the X295 Wraith, SCAR EIR, Stormguard, & Artemis Marksman.
Also addresses marked enemies not receiving bonus damage from Sonic Tracer rounds

Fixed an issue where players could be blinded by the red dot(s) drawn in the world if the targeted location was too close. The red dot will no longer appear on targets that are very close to the modded weapon.
General Perk Changes

Players will now only gain health and gadget energy restoration the *first* time they interact with a trader pod during each trader time. This prevents exploits where players refreshed gadget skills by repeatedly interacting with the trader.
Weapon Cost Reduction Skills (Preferred Customer & Custom Made):
These skills will now also reduce the sell price of the weapon by the same percentage, removing an exploit where weapons could be sold at a profit.
Gunslinger
Pull radius decreased by 40%. Stun affliction amount has been reduced (most noticeable against bosses).
Pull radius increase buffed from {11/15/20/25%} to {15/20/25/30%} to compensate for base radius nerfs.
Trigger explosion radius decreased from 350uu to 225uu. A small 1.25s cooldown has been added between allowed triggers.
Now only applies while using pistol weapons. Fixed an issue where the damage increase wasn't applying properly to secondary and tertiary firing modes.
Fixed an issue where the damage increase wasn't applying properly to secondary and tertiary firing modes.
Healing reduced from {25/30/35/40} to {15/20/25/30}.
Movement speed reduced from {25/30/35/40%} to {15/20/25/30%}. *(Also fixed an issue where it did not work with some shotguns).*
Cost reduction per weapon mod reduced from {4/5/6/7%} to {3/4/5/6%}.
Gadget damage reduction changed from 70% to 80%. Bullet amount increased from {4/6/8/10} to {6/8/10/12}.
Now has 70% damage reduction at all levels (previously {70/60/50/40%}). Ricochet distance slightly increased.
Capped at a maximum of 10 stacks, reducing max armor gain from {30/45/60/75} to {20/30/40/50}.
Now only applies while using pistol weapons. *(Also fixed an issue where it did not heal the player when using explosive damage).*
Now only applies while using pistol weapons.
Fixed an issue where Headcount wasn't applying correctly during Zed time.
Fixed damage buff skills not applying to weapons in double shot mode.
Fixed Dual Der Konig and Desert Eagle bash taking much longer to cooldown than other guns.
Fixed head tracker failing to consistently track headshots during Zed time.
Firebug

The original behavior of the Trenchgun applying Extinguisher on each reload was intended, but a recent exploit has been demonstrated that has caused us to re-evaluate. Extinguisher no longer applies on each Trench Gun reload and no longer works on guns without magazines.
From The Ashes has been reworked. It now has a {10/9/8/7} minute cooldown that gets reduced by 5s per kill, instead of only being usable once per match.
Fixed a UI bug where the timer cooldown showed going up instead of down when upgrading the perk
Sharpshooter
Skill reworked into a new skill called Target Practice
Your next shot while aiming down sights with a Ballistic or Cold weapon deals {60/70/80/90%} increased damage. The bonus is doubled against armor (8s cooldown between triggers).
Skill - Easy Prey
Now only applies to Ballistic and Cold damage.
Medic
Now only applies to Ballistic, Biological, and Corrosive damage.
Engineer
Fixed a bug where Scatter Plot could work with some Ninja weapons (Kunai & Shuriken).
Stability & Performance
Resolved a Load Error 4 encountered when launching the title.
Fixed a server crash
Fixed an issue causing "Connection lost to online services" during Survival matches on HOE difficulty.
Addressed massive lag spikes encountered on the Weekly mutation "Chaos Cascade" on HoE difficulty.
Fixed an issue where clearing the PSO cache on EGS caused users to get a "Failed to authenticate" error when starting the game.
Fixed a "Server connection lost" error when late joining into a map for the first time with fresh shaders as the 6th player.
Fixed EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat) not being installed correctly via Steam
UI, HUD, & Menus
Fixed users joining a party from the friends list being transferred late to the Ready Up screen.
Fixed an issue causing the Ready-up Screen countdown to end at -1 seconds left.
Fixed the Map Select dropdown not updating to the map name when selecting an option in the matchmaking menu, and remaining accessible while matchmaking is in progress.
Fixed map selection resetting to the default choice when exiting the play tab/mission select without starting matchmaking.
Fixed the "Matchmaking" setting being invisible, then appearing set to off when selecting a map in Play Multiplayer.
Fixed "Chaos Cascade" incorrectly displaying the boss wave with dev text during wave 5 trader time.
Operational budget will no longer appear as 0 when first loading into Ready Up on consoles.
\ Fixed default button layout presets resetting to Custom layout after relaunching the title.
\[Controller/PC] Fixed the Back button lacking functionality when entering Keyboard Mapping with a controller.
Gameplay & Systems
Fixed a critical issue where clients would lose access to the HUD and scoreboard if they died just before the round ends.
Fixed Vulcan TA failing to apply direct impact damage during gameplay.
Fixed Melee Bash not behaving consistently, adjusting cooldowns that were too long for certain weapons.
Fixed an exploit where players could animation-cancel melee bash to create unintended, extremely high attack rates.
Addressed an issue where progressions/proficiency levels for all perks temporarily dropped with the new update.
Fixed the Headcount Achievement being tracked per Perk, which allowed progress to go backwards.
Fixed Ninja Gadget cord appearing stuck on screen when firing at the ground, and visually offsetting from targets ("Weird Grabs").
Fixed Ninja getting into a semi-broken state while sliding and activating a turret at the same time.
Fixed the Ninja Gadget bringing the Husk over the barrier without dealing the final charged punch on Onslaught.
Fixed an issue where the explosion from large Zed executions could miss Zeds within range.
Fixed players being unable to craft Heavy-Action Hammer and Refined-Action Hammer Internal mods for the Pyre .357 Firebug Sidearm custom loadouts.
Fixed 1P Medic sidearms (Dual KH-380s) slides going back after a full reload.
Primary Directive: Slaughterhouse will now be correctly limited to the Onslaught map.
Fixed inability to ping through the Medic Sanctum gadget.
Addressed two trader pings being present in Trader Time after using resupply during a wave.
The Trader trail should now always be present for all party participants.
Maps & Environments
Fixed assets and 1P weapons missing after clearing PSO.
Fixed Stronghold lighting becoming extremely blown out or extremely dark.
Fixed map being selectable for Weekly Mutation after returning to Stronghold.
Fixed Cryo lab holdout objective ring having opaque sections.

notes.title: New Gameplay Feature — Zed Bump Physics

items.text: A new mobility-based takedown system lets players use movement as both offense and defense. You can now push Zeds out of the way by sprinting when cornered, giving you a chance to break free. This same system allows for stumbles and knockdowns through movement-based impacts like sliding and sprinting—though it won’t trigger if the Zed is actively attacking.
Landing on their heads will knock them down—and if you drop from far enough, you’ll obliterate them instantly.
Sprinting, sliding, or dashing into smaller targets will also stumble and knock them over.
This works on Crawlers, Crawler Larvae, Cysts, Clots, Mire Clots, Mire Cysts, Bloats, Gorefasts, Sirens, and Husks.

As a heads-up if all goes well, we are targeting tomorrow morning to roll out hotfix 3. The target time is 9:00 a.m EDT.

We are continuing to actively investigate performance, matchmaking, and stability as primary concerns. Our goal is to implement fixes that address identified issues within upcoming releases, while ensuring that any optimizations provide a consistent and stable gameplay experience through thorough testing and iteration.

Release Date Target: August 27th, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. EDT.
Balance Tunes
The Husk's ranged attack has been rebalanced to give players more counterplay.
Its charge-up is now slower, creating a clutch opportunity to shoot and destroy the cannon before it fires.
In addition, the homing on its fireball has been reduced, making the projectile easier to dodge with sharp movement
Armor has been reworked to provide more consistent protection and eliminate frustrating edge cases.
The new curve makes armor absorb a greater share of incoming damage, preventing situations where players die while still holding a large armor reserve.
This also resolves the problem of being one-shot while at full health and full armor, making survivability feel more reliable.
Increased Proficiency Awarded for completing waves for Hard and Hell on Earth
Hard from 10 to 12
Hell on Earth from, 12 to 16
Biosteel drop rates have been significantly increased across all difficulty levels:
Normal: 2.5% to 4%
Hard: 2.5% to 4.5%
Hell on Earth: 2.5% to 5%
Bug Fixes
Stability Fixes
Investigated and patched memory leaks on the Military Base map.
Performance Optimization
Trimmed down VFX emitters to optimize CPU performance
Change Default Frame Rate Cap to Unlimited
Note: this was done based on findings that the current frame rate cap setting incorrectly applies additional performance overhead compared to uncapped that we are looking to address at a later date.
Optimized Clot Zed death behavior to reduce performance spikes
Reduced overhead from moving car environment assets in City Streets
Reduced or eliminated various VFX emitters to increase performance
We hired an exterminator to get rid of the roaches on the maps that were hurting performance.
Improved UI performance in various areas such as the name plates.
Reduced performance impact on various Husk attacks
Turned off masked materials for weapons and mods where they were unnecessary to increase rendering performance
Matchmaking
Resolved a bug allowing more than 6 players to join an online match.
Players should no longer encounter an issue where rejoining a party with five members incorrectly displayed a "party full" message.
Gameplay & UI
Added save points on each wave start for better mid-match progression and experience tracking
Improved cases where the "Complete All Daily Challenges" assignment would not consistently complete or reward players.
Corrected multiplayer bug where Explosive Rounds did not damage Clots and Cysts.
Fixed an issue where Kunai speed attacks did not adapt to Zed Time when it triggered.
Fixed a rare bug where Scrakes became stuck in a looping grab animation if their hook was broken.
Resolved issues with Audio Events not firing appropriately
Fixed audio bug where "damage taken" SFX triggered despite avoiding hits.
Resolved sprint bug where running would not resume after ADS + shooting.
Future Update Preview

Following Hotfix 3, the team is already working towards another hotfix to address additional issues around stability and optimization as well as our Rearmament Update later this Fall as previewed at launch within our Post-Launch Roadmap here: Killing Floor 3: The Start Of A Journey And The Year 1 Roadmap

items.text: [img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/kf3/kf3hotfix.jpg"]

We are actively investigating performance as a primary concern. Our goal is to implement fixes that address identified issues within upcoming hotfixes and releases, while ensuring that any optimizations provide a consistent and stable gameplay experience through thorough testing and iteration.

To show our appreciation for your patience as we release these hotfixes for a more stable experience, we are granting all players a free 500 Creds. These will be added to your accounts upon logging in after this update.
Performance Optimization
Improved performance related to masked materials on foliage.
Optimized framerate spikes related to Siren Scream Shockwaves.
Matchmaking

Resolved issues where players would get stuck indefinitely searching for a match. If players still encounter this, please let us know via our investigation thread here so we can dive into any remaining cases: https://forums.tripwireinteractive.com/index.php?threads/infinite-matchmaking-investigation-thread.2343253/
Dedicated South African servers have been added to improve latency in the region.
Improved matchmaking prioritization to better select regional servers based on player connection location.
Note: We are continuing to investigate solutions for client-to-game server connection latency issues, even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.
Addressed errors on servers in which clients remain connected to inactive server sessions.
Addressed server stability issues that don’t recover cleanly after termination.
Gameplay & UI
Corrected an issue where Impaler attack VFX would improperly replicate and play infinitely when parties split across the map.
Visuals
Continued to improve the visual behavior of shadows incorrectly rendering on large Zeds.
Fixed visual issues with Zeds affected by the Enfeeble incapacitation.
Following Hotfix 2, the team is already working towards Hotfix 3 and beyond. A short, non exhaustive, WIP list of items being worked on (all items subject to move as work continues) includes:
Overall Performance & Stability
UI Performance Improvements
VFX Performance Improvements
Improve performance for when Medic bag(s) are on screen
Improving client stability, with a focus around certain hardware combinations
Optimization to network traffic to reduce cases where players experience latency issues, even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.
Fix for players ending up in a seemingly de-synced state from the server with jittery movement even when connected to the appropriate local region data center.
Performance spikes
Performance Improvements for in-game resource load
Reduce memory footprint on splatter maps
Improve framerate spikes caused by blood splatter.
Improve handling of players and servers that would end up in a “bad state” which would result in players being unable to matchmake

Killing Floor 3 - Live Stream Update

items.text: Hey all, we have a quick update regarding Killing Floor 3 for you.

We’ve heard you. We are cancelling our live stream tomorrow, February 27th to do some more deep dives into all the ways we can improve the Killing Floor 3 experience and are building a detailed action plan to address that.
We’ll have more detailed news to share in the near future!

releases.displayName: Closed Beta Status Update

items.text: Hello everyone,

We want to let everyone know where things are at with the Killing Floor 3 closed beta. As of 3 hours ago, keys have started to be sent out in waves to those who filled out the onboarding survey. These are continuing to go out, so please keep an eye on your email and check your spam folder.
While the original intent was for this build to also come online tomorrow with the other platforms, it is active now and it will stay live until the end of the beta on the 24th at 11:00 AM EST.
Fans who have pre-ordered the game should no longer have any issues redeeming their beta code on Steam.
Some activities we have seen that you should not do.
Do not share your code publicly or with somebody else even if it errored out for you. They may be able to redeem it leaving you unable to play in the beta
Do not remove the game from your library (non refund path) to be able to input your beta key, as this will leave you without a product after the beta period ends.
Be sure to review our Beta FAQ available here, and we look forward to your feedback! We’ll update this announcement as needed over the course of the beta.
